title: console: 403 permission denial rendered as a network-connection error in list views
body:
## Symptom

When a list data fetch is denied with **403 PERMISSION_DENIED**, the console renders the same panel as a network outage: "无法加载记录 / 加载数据时出错。请检查网络连接后重试。" ("Couldn't load records / …Check your connection and try again.").

Reproduced with request-level evidence: a restricted role opening an object list shows the network-error panel while the network tab shows the request answered `403 Forbidden`; an admin on the same page sees a normal empty state.

## Why it matters

Users are told to debug their connectivity while the server is (correctly) denying access — ops chase network ghosts, and every unauthorized menu entry produces the same misleading message.

## Expected

`ListView`'s error panel must classify the failure (HTTP status / error code) and show permission-denied (403) and sign-in-required (401) copy distinct from the connectivity message.

Found via real-app dogfooding (os-tianshun-ehr platform defect registry PLAT-DEF-018, on 17.0.0-rc.0).
